techmeme.title: GTA VI's 5,000-strong team eschewed AI and procedural generation in favor of handcrafted "fidelity", with 30,000 unique NPCs and an in-game video game system (Joseph Bernstein/New York Times)
IEA expects global data center investment to hit $4T by 2030; fewer than 100 major AI projects would require a combined 50GW of power, matching peak UK demand (Will Mathis/Bloomberg)
Dustin Moskovitz, one of Anthropic's earliest investors, says he "invested in Anthropic to promote safety, not racing" and frontier AI labs "should slow down" (New York Times)
Analysis: Anthropic needs ~$602B in annual revenue to hit a 20% return on invested capital comparable to its Big Tech peers; Apple has $478B in annual revenue (Financial Times)
Germany and Austria submit a proposal urging the EU to require TikTok to find a local owner for its European operations to combat TikTok's ties to Beijing (Bloomberg)
